num_blackman_gap_lower_relerr.note: relative to the closed-form gap; find_roots at xtol 1e-14 on a stationary point, so the error is second order in xtol; measured 1.6e-16

num_blackman_gap_switch_relerr.note: relative to 1/3; exact arithmetic, 1 - 2/3 against 1/3, measured 1.7e-16

num_blackman_Sstar_over_Ks_relerr.note: relative to S*/K_S; the root's guarantee xtol + rtol|x| is 2.5e-14 relative here; measured 0

contois_map_mum_relerr.note: relative to the Monod mu_m; two least_squares exits; measured 2.7e-8 to 3.7e-8 across BLAS kernels

contois_map_KS_relerr.note: relative to the Monod K_S; two least_squares exits; measured 1.1e-7 to 2.9e-7 across BLAS kernels, the bound is about 3400x the largest

contois_minus_monod_rms.note: one curve fitted twice; two least_squares exits; measured 7.6e-15 to 1.5e-13 across BLAS kernels, the bound is about 650x the largest

sep_moser.note: Moser contains Monod at n = 1; least_squares at xtol 1e-13; measured 2.8e-14 to 8.3e-14 across BLAS kernels and above 1e-12 on other machines; 1e-9 is also the degeneracy threshold

sep_contois.note: Contois is Monod under a constant yield; least_squares at xtol 1e-13; measured 1.2e-13 to 1.5e-13 across BLAS kernels; 1e-9 is also the degeneracy threshold

Sf_crossing_vs_a_relerr.note: relative to a; S_f = a identically, the gap is the Contois fit's two exit tolerances (decomposed on the page); measured 1.0e-7 to 1.7e-7 across BLAS kernels, the bound is about 5800x the largest

rawlings_10_19_max_relerr.note: relative to the closed-form steady state; LSODA at rtol 1e-11 marched to t = 40000; measured exactly 0

pymrm_batch_observed_order.note: backward Euler is first order in dt; finest triple 100/200/400 of the successive differences, the interval farthest from 1

pymrm_batch_order_roundoff_margin.note: smallest finest successive difference of the seven predictions over newton's backward_tol 1e-8 times the prediction

pymrm_batch_conservation_relerr.note: relative to S + X/phi; backward Euler keeps a linear invariant of the source to round-off; measured 1.4e-16 to 2.9e-16 across BLAS kernels, the bound is about 350x the largest

pymrm_refit_mum_relerr.note: two-route gap, LSODA fit against Richardson-extrapolated backward Euler at 200/400 steps; set by the two fits' stopping rules, measured 7.0e-7 to 8.2e-7 across BLAS kernels; the bound is the prose claim and 1e2 below the 25-step row

pymrm_refit_KS_relerr.note: as for mu_m; measured 2.5e-6 to 3.4e-6 across BLAS kernels; the bound is the prose claim and below the unconverged 25-step refit

pfr_observed_order.note: first-order upwind; finest triple 1600/3200/6400 of the successive differences of the outlet from compute_boundary_values

pfr_richardson_relerr.note: Richardson value of the finest triple (observed order) against the batch state: a discretisation residual

pfr_order_roundoff_margin.note: finest successive difference of the outlet over newton's backward_tol 1e-8 times the outlet value: the order is read far above the solver floor

routeA_monod_last_margin.note: route-A Monod RMS minus the largest of the other three two-parameter laws: Monod is last of the four exactly when this is positive

boot_control_size_offset_se.note: distance of the control's size from 0.05 in binomial standard errors of a nominal test at NBOOT draws: 'at nominal' means within three

boot_control_scale_free_se.note: the control's size at route A's scatter minus at route B's, in binomial standard errors: 'scale-free' means within three

boot_edge_fraction_main.note: fraction of the 2 NBOOT draws at route B's scatter whose scan optimum is on a grid edge; 0 to 3 draws over twelve seeds (SEED + 1000 to SEED + 1011), the bound is ten draws, about three times the largest

blind_yield_gap_change_over_move.note: change of the LSODA-versus-pymrm gap under a 30 % yield error, over the prediction's own move: 'blind' means the gap moves by a small part of it

marcher_invariant_mu_tripled_relerr.note: S + X/phi after tripling mu_m, relative: backward Euler conserves the linear invariant of the source (-m/phi, m) for any growth law; a different yield in the source from the one in the invariant breaks it

Sf_rootfind_over_guarantee.note: a solver-contract bound: the S_f crossing's distance from S_f = a over find_roots' guaranteed accuracy xtol + rtol|x|, which no physics row can move

routeA_F_imputed_below_crit.note: F(1,4) critical value minus route A's F with row 4 imputed: the imputation flips the verdict exactly when this is positive

flagged_row.note: the row (1-based) whose removal raises the balance line's R^2 most; margin: R^2 over the next best removal

n_separable_alternatives.note: alternatives with a separation above the SEP_BOUND 1/h bound, so that N* is defined: Blackman and Tessier; margin in decades to that bound on the separable side, the degenerate side held by its two bound claims; decided by the identities, which no row can move
